name: Fujiwara no Toshiyuki
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 18); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 880–907.

poems.title: To-night on Sumi-no-ye beach
poems.author: Fujiwara no Toshiyuki
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 18
poems.text:
To-night on Sumi-no-ye beach
The waves alone draw near;
And, as we wander by the cliffs,
No prying eyes shall peer,
No one shall dream we’re here.
